input.description: CSV samplesheet with sample and assembly columns

run_braker4.description: Run BRAKER4 through its Snakemake workflow

run_helixer.description: Run Helixer ab initio gene prediction

braker4_source.description: Unmodified BRAKER4 folder installed by scripts/setup_braker4.sh

braker4_commit.description: BRAKER4 commit Meristem is tested with; the run stops if braker4_source is another version

braker4_allow_unpinned.description: Run with a BRAKER4 folder that is not the tested commit

braker4_busco_lineage.description: odb12 BUSCO lineage used inside BRAKER4 (compleasm); must exist in <busco_db>/lineages

braker4_runner_container.description: Optional container with Snakemake and the BRAKER4 runner dependencies

braker4_snakemake.description: Snakemake executable used to run BRAKER4

braker4_singularity_prefix.description: Shared cache for BRAKER4's nested Singularity containers

braker4_singularity_args.description: Bind arguments passed to BRAKER4's nested Singularity jobs

helixer_container.description: Helixer image; a local .sif path also works

helixer_container_options.description: Optional Apptainer options, e.g. --nv for GPU inference

multiqc_container.description: Container used for annotation MultiQC reports
